content.text: **Finding: compliant.** The only MFN in the document runs in our favour, and § 12.3 expressly confirms we have given no most-favoured-customer commitment.

input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The sole MFN provision (§ 7.6) is granted by Vendor in our favour: Vendor warrants Fees to Customer will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. That is the outcome the playbook welcomes, so no redline is warranted. No reciprocal or Customer-side MFN exists: § 4 (Order Forms) contains no pricing-benchmarking or best-terms obligation, and § 12.3 affirmatively states that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." Searches for most-favoured-nation, benchmarking, third-party offer matching, and best-terms language returned no obligation binding Customer. Preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is met.
